text:
elaine: FYI opened a docs PR to consolidate batch/cache/quant guidance into a single "optimize-toolkit" page. Need owners for SDK snippets and a short migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499 :memo:

owen: i'll take python + node SDK snippets. can we standardize on the `QuantProfile.recommend(...)` API and show both latency/cost examples?

elain e: yes — recommend both. minimal snippet for python: 
```
from redwood import Client, QuantProfile
client = Client()
q = QuantProfile.recommend(model='redwood-3b', target='cost')
client = client.with_quant(q)
print(client.generate('Extract bullets from...'))
```

rahul: added a short perf note: dynamic batching (max_batch=12) + prefix cache gave ~30% token savings on our chat dataset. will drop raw numbers in PR comments. also note that `batch_window_ms` was moved under `batching.window_ms` in Dedicated config.

owen: i'll update the perf table and add a small "when to use quant" decision flowchart.

docs-bot: PR 499 merged by elaine. Site build: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize-toolkit (build 2026-03-21_12:10). :white_check_mark:

rahul: quick reminder - KV cache can be invalidated when you switch quant profiles. added a one-liner "gotcha" in migration checklist.

elain e: thanks team. i'll follow up with a tiny integration test suggestion in the docs to catch regressions on quant+cache changes.
